_source: Hand-written from unifi-cli's tracked source (lib/api/map/map.mjs endpoint rows and the task/request shapes) and the UniFi documentation — documentation addresses (RFC 5737) and MACs (RFC 7042) only; ids are patterned. The v2 collection can also answer a bare array of the same rows; the reader accepts both shapes (legacyRequest + envelopeData).
